english:
Picking up <stasis Stasis Shards /> progresses the Crystalline Converter Counter.

Dealing <stasis Stasis /> Melee or Diamond Lance damage consumes the Counter and spawns <stasis Stasis Crystals /> based on the number of Shards picked up: 1|2|3 Crystals with 8|12|15 Shard pickups.

Using a Class Ability makes the next <stasis Stasis /> Weapon Kill spawn a <stasis Stasis Shard />.

source.text:
Picking up Stasis Shards progresses the Crystalline Converter Counter.

Upon dealing Stasis Melee Damage or Diamond Lance Damage: 
Consumes the Crystalline Converter Counter.
Spawns Crystals based on the amount of Shards picked up.
8 | 12 | 15 Shards Pickups
1 | 2 | 3 Crystals Spawned

On Class Ability Usage:
The next Stasis Weapon Kill spawns a Stasis Shard.
